summary: DatePicker component and recurring end_date feature testing completed. Backend: 8/8 tests passed (100%). Frontend: 12/12 tests passed (100%). All features working correctly including date picker calendar modal, recurring end_date, transaction sorting by time, and edit mode hiding frequency picker.

frontend_issues.cache_note: Initial testing showed cached version of app. Required cache clear (localStorage.clear(), sessionStorage.clear()) and page reload to see updated DatePicker component. This is expected behavior in web preview.

critical_code_review_comments: ✅ Backend: POST /api/transactions with YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS sorts correctly - transactions with later times appear at top (bug fix verified)
✅ Backend: POST /api/recurring with end_date returns end_date in response
✅ Backend: POST /api/recurring WITHOUT end_date returns end_date=null and rule stays active
✅ Backend: POST /api/recurring with end_date BEFORE start_date returns 400
✅ Backend: Materialization respects end_date - generates exactly 2 transactions for weekly rule from 2026-04-01 to 2026-04-10
✅ Backend: Rule becomes active=false after end_date passes
✅ Backend: Rule with future end_date stays active and generates transactions up to today
✅ Frontend: DatePicker component renders with human-readable date format (e.g., 'Apr 19, 2026')
✅ Frontend: Calendar modal opens with testID=date-picker-prev-month, date-picker-next-month, date-picker-today, date-picker-close
✅ Frontend: Day cells present with testID=date-picker-day-YYYY-MM-DD format (found 30 cells)
✅ Frontend: Selecting a day closes modal and updates date label
✅ Frontend: Frequency picker visible in create mode (testID=frequency-once, frequency-weekly, etc.)
✅ Frontend: End date picker (Repeat until) appears when frequency != 'once' (testID=end-date-picker)
✅ Frontend: End date picker opens calendar modal with testID=end-date-picker-prev-month, etc.
✅ Frontend: Clear button visible for end date picker (testID=end-date-picker-clear)
✅ Frontend: Creating transaction with today's date saves successfully and appears at top of activity list
✅ Frontend: Edit mode correctly hides frequency picker and end_date picker (!isEdit condition working)
✅ Frontend: toIsoWithNowTime function combines YYYY-MM-DD with current HH:MM:SS for proper sorting

bug_fix_verification.issue: Transactions with same date but different times were not sorting correctly. Frontend was sending YYYY-MM-DDT00:00:00+00:00 which sorted below same-day transactions with real timestamps.
bug_fix_verification.fix: Frontend now uses toIsoWithNowTime() function to combine YYYY-MM-DD with current HH:MM:SS, ensuring new transactions sort at top of same-day list.
bug_fix_verification.verification: Backend test confirmed: transaction with 15:30:00 appears before transaction with 10:00:00 in GET /api/transactions response (sorted by date DESC).
